patch_description: Builds on the best prior program (combined 0.58: adaptive Kalman + Savitzky-Golay + weighted window mean, 41 slope changes, 36.6 false reversals). Its weakness is the unbounded NIS-driven process-noise multiplier `q_scale = q_base*(1+10*min(nis,50)/10)` which can inflate Q to 51×q_base, leaking noise into the velocity state and causing spurious reversals. New configuration: (1) cap the multiplier at 4× (`q_scale = q_base*min(1.0+nis/10.0, 4.0)`), (2) raise q_base from 0.01 to 0.02 so genuine turns still track, (3) add a slope median gate that suppresses small slope sign flips (kills false reversals, the metric that best predicts rank), (4) add mild forward extrapolation via the Kalman slope state to cut lag error. This keeps the smoothness/reversal advantage while recovering tracking accuracy and lag.
